entity.label: Meta-Oracle/Scematica: Scematica is going to be designed to be an autonomous Claude enabled trading bot built fully on open-source foundations. The Idea is to have a fully interactive and scalable trading bot that is fully reactive and prediction based. With the code being built from the ground up. It will inherently integrate proper x402, and many other agentic systems.
